Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. This new feature lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild a view from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or organizing work by priority, you can save the setup once and return to it instantly.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views for different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup without repeating configuration steps, which keeps reporting consistent and makes onboarding new teammates faster.

Saved Views is included in every paid plan at no extra cost, and it works across your existing lists right away. We built this based on direct feedback from customers who wanted a faster way to switch between saved contexts without losing their settings.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
